mapper.select: SELECT comment_seq AS commentSeq, user_seq AS userSeq, board_seq AS boardSeq, comment_content AS commentContent, comment_writedate AS commentWritedate, comment_update AS commentUpdate FROM comment WHERE board_seq = #{boardSeq} ORDER BY comment_writedate ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment (user_seq, board_seq, comment_content) VALUES (#{userSeq}, #{boardSeq}, #{commentContent})
